integrity: The unbounded theorem is proved by local partition improvements and a residue-class classification. An exhaustive exact-rational check through \(m=40\) is included only as regression evidence, not as a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only \(D(n)=d(n)/d^*(n)\), equivalently \(k=2\) in \(D_{k,\omega}\). It does not claim the general \(k\ge3\) fixed-\(\Omega\) envelope. The 2012 maximum-order paper was not directly retrievable as a full PDF during the comparison, but its theorem is stated in its indexed abstract and quoted in an inspected 2023 full text.
title: Sharp fixed-\(\Omega\) envelope for the divisor/unitary-divisor ratio
